blocks.text: To deploy your NSS virtual appliance, the Zscaler service needs to compute the appropriate resources for your NSS. To learn more, see the deployment guide linked below for your platform:
You must be subscribed to NSS for Firewall, Cloud and Branch Connector to manage your Cloud & Branch Connector NSS.
For Cloud & Branch Connector, consider only the NSS for Firewall configurations in the deployment guides and ignore the NSS for Web configurations because they are not applicable.
